extensions.name: Colour Swatches
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: A small square of the colour before every colour in your code: #hex, rgb() and hsl(), in CSS, HTML, JS, JSON and more.

extensions.name: Focus Timer
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: Focus in blocks with breaks between, from the status bar. It chimes at the end and counts your blocks for the day.

extensions.name: Git Line
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: The status bar shows who last changed the cursor's line and when. Click it for the commit's message.

extensions.name: HTML Quick
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: Type a short abbreviation like ul>li*3 or div.card>h2+p and press Ctrl+Alt+E to turn it into HTML.

extensions.name: JSON Tools
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: Format, minify or sort the keys of JSON (the selection or the whole file), and see where the error is when it is not valid.

extensions.name: Markdown Tables
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: Line up the columns of the table the cursor is in, add a row or a column, and turn comma- or tab-separated text into a table.

extensions.name: Pet Pack
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: Three more pets for Aether: a frog, a penguin and a bunny, each with three skins.

extensions.name: Quick Insert
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: Put placeholder text, today's date, the time, a unique id, a strong password or a random number at the cursor.

extensions.name: Regex Lab
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: A tab of its own to try a regular expression on some text: matches highlighted, groups listed, and a replace preview.

extensions.name: Text Tools
extensions.author: Redfire3248
extensions.description: Change case (camelCase, snake_case, Title Case and more), and sort, clean up, number or join lines.
